    Description
    Availability
    Availability information for a single employee on a specific day.

    Utility functions to remove all data from schedule related tables.

    Utility for obtaining SQLite database connections bundled with the application resources.

    DAO for managing Employee entities.

    Builds schedules for a single day using OR-Tools to balance load and obey employee availability.
    ScheduleDb
    Utility responsible for creating schedule tables and persisting generated Shift assignments.

    Represents a single shift assignment for an employee.

    Utility methods to print database table contents for debugging.
    TimeRange
    Immutable representation of a start and end time.
